name: Layout Composer
author: Defani Arman Alfitriansyah
description: QGIS-style print layout designer: page-size catalog (ISO, US, KLHK, posters, presentation, social media) in mm/cm/in/pt/px, live map frames with locked scale and GeoLibre capture, DMS/DD/UTM grids, inset maps, auto legends, matplotlib-style color bars (pointed/square ends, tick control, raster ranges), dual-unit scale bars, 26 north arrows, LaTeX formulas, drawing tools (polyline, polygon, Bézier, freehand), shapes with gradient/hatch fills, drop shadow and frosted glass, icon catalog (Maki and Temaki icons), user templates, and PNG/JPG/PDF/vector PDF/GeoPDF/SVG export.
